layers.label: City priority screen
layers.basis: Official hazard + 2026 barrio population + 2023 comuna IMCV combined under explicit policy lenses
layers.use: Transparent shortlist for deeper analysis; not a climate forecast or investment recommendation

layers.label: City socioeconomic vulnerability
layers.use: Relative socioeconomic vulnerability component; coarse within each comuna

layers.label: City population projection
layers.basis: Official Medellín/DANE barrio projections, 2018–2030; Ourea uses 2026 totals
layers.use: City-scale exposure screening; not within-barrio spatial distribution

layers.label: Mass-movement hazard
layers.use: Spatial susceptibility baseline; not event probability

layers.label: Buildings
layers.basis: Medellín cadastral construction geometries and floors

layers.label: Population
layers.basis: DANE 2018 census-block population allocated to buildings by constructed-area share

layers.label: Critical access
layers.use: Access-resilience weighting; not route evacuation simulation

layers.label: Observed rainfall context
layers.basis: CHIRPS v3.0 Final pentad extract for the Llanaditas / upper Comuna 8 0.05° cell; 1991–2020 climatology; daily series allocated uniformly within each pentad
layers.use: Anchor typical, high and extreme planning rainfall contexts; not station intensity and not landslide probability

layers.label: Intervention effects
layers.basis: Published effect ranges used as uncertainty bounds, not locally calibrated slope-performance coefficients

layers.label: Intervention costs
layers.basis: Versioned TRM, DANE IPC and local procurement/public-works comparators; optimizer remains on planning credits
layers.use: Decision-brief implementation envelope; not an offer, contract or engineering estimate
